req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that every player response must include 'firstName' and 'lastName'. The test suite will verify this by checking the presence of these fields in various scenarios: a valid player ID, an invalid player ID, and a boundary case with a valid UUID format but non-existent player.

tests.name: test_get_player_valid_id
preconditions: A player with a known UUID exists in the database.
actions: Send a GET request to /players/{id} with a valid player UUID.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from uuid import uuid4

client = TestClient(app)

# Assume a player with this UUID exists in the test database
valid_player_id = uuid4()

response = client.get(f'/players/{valid_player_id}')
assert response.status_code == 200
json_data = response.json()
assert 'firstName' in json_data
assert 'lastName' in json_data

tests.name: test_get_player_invalid_id
preconditions: No player exists with the given UUID.
actions: Send a GET request to /players/{id} with an invalid player UUID.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from uuid import uuid4

client = TestClient(app)

# Assume no player with this UUID exists in the test database
invalid_player_id = uuid4()

response = client.get(f'/players/{invalid_player_id}')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_get_player_boundary_id
preconditions: The UUID format is valid but does not correspond to any player.
actions: Send a GET request to /players/{id} with a boundary UUID.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Use a valid UUID format that is unlikely to exist
boundary_player_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

response = client.get(f'/players/{boundary_player_id}')
assert response.status_code == 404
